notes: Post-hoc per-class temperature calibrator (scripts/sft/calibration_v6.json, per-class temperature vectors, arm b_temp) on the frozen v5 checkpoint v5_17b — no retraining, checkpoint byte-identical to deem-v5.
Accuracy and ECE (pre/post) are the system numbers on the untouched eval half of the held-out split (sha256(prompt) parity; the calibrator was fit on the dev half only).

Flip rate, negation and exact-laws metrics are the v5 raw-readout probes, unchanged: the calibrator is post-hoc and not permutation-equivariant, so the consistency probes are the checkpoint's own numbers.
Macro ECE gate closes at 0.0433 (target <= 0.06); amazon's 5-way ordinal confusion was the one place a scalar temperature had to serve five miscalibrations.
